meta.method: Imported supplied final-dashboard snapshot; no raw meter reprocessing

validation.mes_count_logic: COUNT DISTINCT normalized OrderNo in mes_production_periods_2026_cleaned.xlsx, excluding blank/null.
validation.excel_count_logic: COUNT DISTINCT normalized Auftragskarte Nr. in excl_production_data_2026_cleaned.xlsx, excluding blank/null.
validation.match_logic: Intersection of the two normalized order-number sets.
validation.disturbance_logic: MES stoppage rows restricted to stoppage_type_code = 1 (Störung), then stoppage_time / 60 to minutes and linked by WorkRecordID to the 2026 production period order.
validation.manual_cause_logic: Minutes are summed from Excel Reinigung/Packmittel/Maschine/Wechsel/Störung minute fields by normalized order.
validation.time_logic: MES order first PointStart / last PointEnd compared with Excel earliest Datum+Beginn / latest Datum+Ende for the same matched order.
validation.energy_logic: Cumulative meter deltas are calculated over the common timestamp window and allocated only where the KM1 production interval overlaps; energy unit remains unspecified in the source.

validation.delta_logic: For each meter independently: interval kWh = current cumulative total_energy_passed - previous non-null cumulative reading, ordered by timestamp. Negative deltas are reset/error candidates and excluded.
validation.allocation_logic: Each positive meter interval is allocated pro-rata by seconds of overlap with non-overlapping KM1 MES production-period intervals (PointStart to PointEnd).
validation.disturbance_logic: Mapped disturbance energy uses overlap with the union of type-1 (Störung) mes_stoppages intervals reconstructed as point_end - stoppage_time and clipped to its KM1 WorkRecord interval.
validation.idle_logic: Idle/unallocated kWh = valid line kWh minus energy allocated to any KM1 production-period interval. It includes true idle energy plus energy in periods without a recorded MES order window.
